mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_export_jobs (id, user_id, status, file_format) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{fileFormat})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ops_export_jobs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_export_jobs SET status = 'processing' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ops_export_jobs SET status = 'failed', error = #{error}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ops_export_jobs SET status = 'expired', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ops_export_jobs SET status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE status = 'processing' AND updated_at < #{cutoff}
